news.title: Trump tells Fed to slash rates or he'll end trade with countries with U.S. surpluses
news.summary: President Donald Trump demanded that the Fed slash interest rates or else he will cut off trade with countries with which the U.S. maintains trade deficits.

news.title: U.S. payrolls rose 162,000 in August, much more than expected; unemployment rate at 4.1%
news.summary: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 53,000 in August while the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

news.title: The big business of personal protection: How private security became a $50 billion industry
news.summary: Private security spending and guard employment have climbed as companies and communities respond to high-profile attacks, even as violent crime falls.

news.title: Süs bitkileri ihracatında Antalya'nın payı yüzde 41,6'ya ulaştı
news.summary: Türkiye'nin süs bitkileri ve mamulleri ihracatının yılın ilk 8 ayında yüzde 41,6'sı Antalya'dan gerçekleştirildi. Kentin toplam ihracatı ise aynı dönemde geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 12,3 arttı.

news.title: Analysis: Lower Treasury yields could require a weaker economy. Trump won't fix them
news.summary: Long-term Treasury yields are being held up by Trump-era policy risk, heavy government borrowing and AI-driven corporate debt.

news.title: 2027 BAYRAM TARİHLERİ: 2026 Kurban Bayramı, Ramazan Bayramı ne zaman?
news.summary: 2027 Kurban Bayramı ve Ramazan Bayramı tarihleri merak ediliyor. İslam alemi yeni yıl yaklaştıkça sorgulamalar artıyor. Zaman zaman gelen soru "2027 Kurban Bayramı, Ramazan Bayramı ne zaman" oluyor.
